tickerText: [TENNIS] Alcaraz and Vacherot lifted Vienna and Basel on Sunday before the Rolex Paris Masters opened Monday with Musetti, Ruud and Rafael Jodar headlining first-round action on Court Central • [SQUASH] PSA Platinum U.S. Open round-of-16 play begins Monday in Philadelphia after Sunday's round of 32, with Malaysia's Sivasangari and Eain Yow among the winners into the last 16 • [BADMINTON] India swept Hylo Open singles in Saarbrücken as Lakshya Sen beat Jonatan Christie and P.V. Sindhu topped Line Kjærsfeldt, with the BWF World Tour shifting toward November's Korea Open in Yeosu • [PICKLEBALL] Team USA swept Latin America 3-0 to win the inaugural MLP Nations Cup on Sunday and Opendoor PPA World Championships pro qualifying kicks off Monday at Brookhaven before the main draw Tuesday • [TABLE TENNIS] WTT Champions Montpellier crowned Sun Yingsha and Jang Woojin on Sunday—Sun beat Kuai Man 4-1 for her 20th WTT title while Jang rallied past Patrick Franziska 4-3 from 1-3 down

newsItems.title: Qualifying Monday
newsItems.excerpt: Brookhaven opens Opendoor PPA Worlds pro qualifying after Team USA swept Latin America 3-0 on Sunday to win the inaugural MLP Nations Cup.

newsItems.title: U.S. Open Last 16
newsItems.excerpt: Philadelphia hosts PSA Platinum round-of-16 night sessions Monday after Sunday's round of 32, with Sivasangari and Eain Yow among those advancing.

newsItems.title: Montpellier Champions
newsItems.excerpt: Sun Yingsha beat Kuai Man 4-1 and Jang Woojin rallied from 1-3 down to edge Patrick Franziska 4-3 as WTT Champions Montpellier closed Sunday.

newsItems.title: Paris Masters Day 1
newsItems.excerpt: Musetti–Hurkacz opens Court Central as Ruud, Jodar and Humbert join Monday's Rolex Paris Masters first round after Alcaraz and Vacherot won Vienna and Basel.
